raw_text: No board-specific pin defaults in library code. No dynamic allocation in steady-state library operation. No logging in library code. No unbounded loops; every wait must have a timeout/deadline. No `delay()` in library code except bounded protocol timing/bit windows. Standard Speed requests must fail cleanly. Do not modify its technical content unless explicitly requested by the maintainer. All fallible APIs return `Status`: const char* msg; No silent failures. Validation/precondition errors must not be disguised as transport failures. During t_WR busy cycle, keep SI/O high and use bounded ready polling.
